title: Smart AI Configuration
subtitle: Select and configure the AI features to include in your application.

configurations.title: Conversational Assistant
configurations.description: Adds a chat panel where end-users can ask natural language questions about their data and workflows.

configurations.title: Anomaly Detection
configurations.description: The AI automatically monitors workflows and alerts users to significant deviations from the norm.

exampleAlert.label: EXAMPLE AI ALERT
exampleAlert.text: "Shipment #SH-9876 has been in Customs for 7 days, which is longer than average."

configurations.title: Predictive Insights
configurations.description: Uses historical data to forecast potential issues, such as late payments or shipment delays.

exampleForecast.label: EXAMPLE AI FORECAST
exampleForecast.text: "Invoice #SI-54321 is at high risk of late payment based on customer history."
